title: Professional Certificate in Effective Recruitment and Evaluation
description: The Professional Certificate in Effective Recruitment and Evaluation aims to equip the learner with in-depth tools and techniques to understand the true nature of the recruitment and evaluation process.
longDescription: Understand the strategic significance of recruitment and the links to employee selection Identify the stages of recruitment Understand the legal context of R&S Evaluate the options for attracting candidates Understand filtering and devise filtering questions Evaluate graduate recruitment procedures Consider the generic psychological characteristics that inform the selection process Appreciate the recruitment and selection process from multiple perspectives The Professional Certificate in Effective Recruitment and Evaluation aims to equip the learner with in-depth tools and techniques to understand the true nature of the recruitment and evaluation process so that the learner is able to effectively manage the recruitment and evaluation functions.
